comment:
Anchor values for resource_model_hybrid.py. Every entry cites its source.
Evidence levels: MEASURED_HETZNER = real Retail-1.07/Wine run reported in this
repository or a referenced PR branch (#47/#51/#56). DERIVED = arithmetic on
measured anchors. PROJECTED = linear extrapolation outside the measured range.
NOTHING in this file was measured inside the LMArena sandbox; no live Wine
benchmark exists for these values.

arch_a_shared_clients.description: Architecture A (status quo / PR #45): 1x DedicatedServer + 2x SeriousSam.exe mit je 4 lokalen Bot-Spielern, Build04 NullRender, 20 Hz. Acht Bots, offene Flotte.

arch_b_individual_clients.description: Architecture B (PR #47): ein kompletter Retail-Client pro Bot, privater Server, Loopback-Namespace, Overlay-Mounts, private cgroup. Acht-Bot-Versuche am 1068-MiB-Reserve-Gate blockiert.
arch_b_individual_clients.redstation_attempt_failure: privater Admin-Drain-Timeout (expressiv nicht als RAM-Ursache bewertet)

derived.arch_b_fit_check_8_clients_note: linear fit prognostiziert 1960.9 MiB fuer 8; der unabhängige Redstation-Lauf peaked bei 1725.9 MiB mit 7 joined + 1 joining, Fit ist konservativ innerhalb ~12%
derived.arch_a_rss_per_bot_note: (188436+188820)/8, shared-RSS-Rechnung - NICHT marginale Pro-Bot-Kosten; PSS nie gemessen
